name: Mother Ostankya
canonNotes: A hag of Kislevite legend, called an apostate by some and a guardian of the land by others, who punishes anyone with ill intent toward Kislev.
Rumoured to have been a powerful Ice Witch who fell foul of the Ice Court; she comes when Kislev is at war, on her own terms.
voiceNotes: Cackling, folksy and sly; speaks in riddles, curses and old sayings.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
